description: Graphite's dependency updates: Renovate on our Forgejo since 2026-11-15, when Graphite's canonical repository moved there (GitHub is its push mirror). A push to main publishes the registry and showcase to https://emiluzelac-graphite.vercel.app from Forgejo CI. Estate defaults come from the preset emiluzelac/renovate-config. Everything waits for review: the registry's components are copied into other apps (um.chat among them) by `shadcn add`, so an update can change what they install.
